title: Dossiers: Name, Patterns, and Becoming an App
summary: NAME DECIDED 9 AUGUST: **Dossier**. UI + documentation rename tracked as AGT-2539; website cards unblocked (AOW-13 Hub working model, WEB-18 Studio site element, dependsOn WEB-16). IN IMPLEMENTATION 9 AUGUST (operator: "This works; go ahead"): slices run as AGT-2533 (keys + references) -> AGT-2534 (VERY compact viewer header) / AGT-2535 (central page + project list + SignalR) / AGT-2537 (documented stage) / AGT-2538 (refresh card); AGT-2536 (template v2 + pattern field) in parallel. Open at the time: NAME (round 2: Task-*/Epic direction; recommendation Dossier, alternatives Charter/Initiative/Task Docs/Task Companion) -> followed by rename and website slice (AOW-13). Section 08 corrected: a Dossier groups the ENTIRE lifecycle. Meta-Dossier about the Dossier concept itself (operator request, 9 August). Inventory of the current mechanism, thesis: Dossier = preliminary stage of a task, partly the operator backlog, almost the ideal working model. Decision areas: name (4 candidates, recommendation Concepts, AGT-2520 collision note), navigation integration, two first-class patterns (ui-heavy vs. concept-heavy), Medium-style article layout with full-bleed mockups (demonstrated by the document itself), more app behavior (live task tracking, refresh cards, interactivity based on AGT-2520). New on 9 August: relationship to Epics (an Epic groups decided work, while a Dossier groups emerging work), central cross-project page analogous to Epics with decisions from the list, complete lifecycle: Dossiers that are not discarded track work through completion and then become documentation (documented stage); explanation of the working model on agent-orchestrator.dev as slice 7 (AOW backlog card). Also new: project-level list as a dedicated page and SignalR events (created/updated/decisionRecorded/statusChanged) for tree/lists/viewer as the multi-user foundation. Practical evidence: four new Dossiers were listed through the API but invisible in the tree until reload. New on 9 August: Dossier keys modeled after card keys (AGT-W4, automatic assignment through a project sequence, click-to-copy chip, cards reference by key; this makes the live task block derivable instead of manually maintained). Slice plan with 8 slices, keys as slice 1.
